Chebyshev’s inequality gives
\[
\Pr(|\bar X_n-p|<0.1)\ge1-\frac{p(1-p)}{0.01n}\ge1-\frac{25}{n}.
\]
Requiring this bound to be at least \(0.9\) yields \(n\ge250\). Thus \(\boxed{250}\) tosses suffice uniformly in \(p\). This is the minimum certified by Chebyshev’s inequality, not necessarily the exact binomial minimum.
